name: Tenkawa Ayumi
source:
A student with a friendly, brazen personality and a bit of a cocky streak. She is a fun-loving and good-natured person, but will not approach anything that she is not interested in. She is a member of the cheerleading squad.
The protagonist catches her stealing test questions from the staff room, which leads to her rape and humiliation.

[Translated from [url=http://www.bishop.gr.jp/products/hkgie/character.html]offical character page[/url]]
